label: Computed from this table times the trace's estimated tokens. Not a measured bill.

deepseek.basis: Off-peak cache-miss list price. Official docs double every rate at peak (weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC) and charge much less on a cache hit. The benchmark prices every estimated token at the off-peak cache-miss rate so the figure does not depend on a cache or a clock.

ocgo.source: examples/demo-state.json cost_in/cost_out bands, assigned by policy.json ocgo.monthly_limits.go
ocgo.unit: USD per 1M tokens, subscription accounting prices
ocgo.basis: OpenCode Go is a subscription. openswarm turns these per-token costs into a fraction of each model's monthly cap (policy.json ocgo.window_fractions: 5h=0.2, 7d=0.5, 30d=1.0). The only per-token costs shipped in-repo are the three demo-state models. Cap 60 uses cheap-flash (0.1/0.4), cap 30 would use mid-coder (0.5/2.0), cap 15 uses big-pro (1.5/6.0). No model in this catalogue has cap 30.

codex.source: No per-token price is published for the ChatGPT/Codex window. openswarm reads used_percent from session rate_limits.
codex.unit: share of a nominal 5h token budget
codex.basis: Share = (estimated input + output tokens routed to Codex) / 2000000. The budget is a benchmark convention so subscription use is a fraction instead of a raw token count. It is not an OpenAI quota. Compare tools on this same denominator only.
